text.en:
The former barrios (now barangays) of Ahan, Muti, Bagan, Lumbayao, Tamar, Tambunan I,
Tambunan II, Kalumamis, Sampao, Fugotan, Boboguiron, Muslim, Marader, Kidate, South Binangga, North
Binangga, Katibpuan, Damabalk, Nunangan, Brar, Talayan, Fukol, Lanting, Linamonan, Macasampan,
Kateman, Midtimbang, and Timbaluan in the municipality of Datu Piang and the Former barrios (now
barangays) of Talitay, Kuden, Gadungan, Mangay, Bintan, Pageda, Makadayon, Kilalan, Kiladap, Adaon and
Mapayag in the municipality of Dinaig, all in the province of Maguindanao, are hereby separated from their
respective municipalities and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality to be known as the
municipality of Talayan.

The seat of government of the Municipality of Talayan shall be at the former barrio (now
barangay) Midtimbang.

The present elective officials of the Municipality of Datu Piang shall perform their duties as such
in the newly created municipality until the officials of the latter shall have duly appointed by the President and
shall have qualified, and they shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the election for
provincial and municipal officials following the issuance of this decree, and shall have qualified, unless
sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Other officials and employees necessary in the organization
and operation of the municipal government shall be appointed in the manner provided for under existing laws.

All laws, decrees, executive orders, ordinances, rules and regulations, or parts thereto,
inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
